opening_message:
Ticket 1: Keith Mclaughlin (employee ID E032) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E032.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Keith Mclaughlin (E032), Analyst, full-time employee, requests write access to Source Code. Full-time employees may have up to write access (admin requires owning role; Analyst does not own Source Code). Requested level is within policy, so recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E032 is a contractor with basic security training (HR note listed full-time; Security DB is authoritative here). Contractors with basic training max out at read; write requires advanced training. Recommend read.
reason: Security DB (authoritative) shows E032 is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors max out at read unless they have advanced training (write); admin is never allowed. Requested write exceeds the maximum, so grant the maximum: read.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Ticket 1: Keith Mclaughlin (E032) requests write access to Source Code.

There are two notes with conflicting information:
- HR note: full-time employee, Analyst, recommendation write
- Security note: contractor with basic security training, recommendation read; says Security DB is authoritative

The security note says the employee is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors max at read (or write with advanced training). Basic training means max read.

The requested level is write. Maximum is read (since contractor, basic training). So grant the maximum = read.

The HR note said full-time but Security DB is authoritative per the note. As the Approver, I need to decide. The security note explicitly states their DB is authoritative. So the employee is a contractor with basic training, max read.

Decision: read.

Let me submit.
